capabilities._note: mode t2a: the wording alone makes the voice. reference_audio is FALSE on purpose. LTXVReferenceAudio ("LTXV Reference Audio (ID-LoRA)") is installed and the graph code can wire it in (targets/audio/ltx2_voice/target.py patch_graph), but with the installed LTX-2.5 transformers it produces silence: three live runs on 2026-09-19 (stereo and mono 5 s references, identity_guidance_scale 3.0 and 0.0, everything else identical to a run that produced 6.0 s of speech at peak 211/255) came back at peak 4/255 and 0/255 with no energy above the noise floor. The node only sets `ref_audio` on the conditioning; the model has to carry the audio ID-LoRA weights to use it, and no such file is installed or recorded in ComfyUI-Manager's model list on this machine. Turn it on (and name the weights under `models`) when they are.

template._note: How long a generated sample is. LTX-2 renders 8k+1 audio frames at the conditioning's frame rate, so a request in seconds is snapped onto that grid (targets/audio/common.py is the wording; the grid is here). 20 s is the same ceiling the ltx2 video target uses; LTXVEmptyLatentAudio's own maximum is 1000 frames.

recipe._note: The brief is targets/audio/common.py's, for every audio target: who is speaking, the series config's `voice` line, and a line to say (the character's longest line in this episode's script, else a neutral sentence).

binding._note: An API graph built for this target (no saved canvas has an audio-only LTX graph): UNETLoader -> LTXVAudioOnlyModel, the LTX-2.5 gemma text encoder, an empty video latent (LTXVAudioOnlyEmptyVideoLatent) concatenated with LTXVEmptyLatentAudio, LTXVDualCFGGuider, LTXVScheduler + SamplerCustomAdvanced, then LTXVSeparateAVLatent -> LTXVAudioVAEDecode. H3SaveRefAudio takes SaveAudio's place and writes the take's wav. Validated live against ComfyUI 0.36.0 on 2026-09-19.

reference_audio._note: Where patch_graph splices LTXVReferenceAudio in when a voice ref has a sample to copy (capabilities.reference_audio). The LoadAudio node reads the uploaded sample by name; the guider then reads the patched model and conditioning.

models._note: Families as the ltx2 video target declares them (targets/modelid.py). The distilled transformer is an accelerator: without it the pass renders `base`, the LTX-2.5 dev transformer at 30 steps and audio cfg 6 (a substitute must say `distilled` or `dev` like the wanted file: `keep`). The text encoder and the audio VAE are required. LTXVAudioVAELoader is not used: it reads models/checkpoints, and the audio VAEs are installed in models/vae, which VAELoader lists.

nodes._note: Beyond the workflow's own classes: the two nodes the reference-audio path would add. Optional, so a ComfyUI without them is `degraded`, not blocked (the path is off anyway: capabilities.reference_audio).

presets._note: The installed LTX-2.5 22B distilled transformer (int8) through LTXVScheduler at 8 steps, audio cfg 1, euler_ancestral: about 25 s for an 8 s sample on this machine. `base` is the dev transformer at 30 steps and audio cfg 6, for a ComfyUI that has the dev model and not the distilled one. `identity_guidance_scale` is the reference-audio path's, kept here so it is one edit away when the ID-LoRA weights exist.

final.negative: music, song, singing, instrumental, score, crowd, applause, second voice, noise, static, hum, distortion, clipping, heavy reverb, echo, silence

downloads._note: Where to get each file this target names (docs/API.md 'Downloads'). Every URL here comes from ComfyUI-Manager's model list on this machine (user/__manager/cache/4245046894_model-list.json); the audio VAE is also in the video_ltx2_5_i2v template's properties.models.
